stem: A patient from Delhi has acute fever, arthralgia, petechiae and severe thrombocytopenia with prolonged bleeding time but normal clotting time. What is the most likely diagnosis?
answer_explanation: Dengue commonly causes fever, myalgia/arthralgia, rash or petechiae and thrombocytopenia.
